messages:
Lena M: Heads-up from the postmortem follow-up: we need a concise preflight checklist and clear owners for the DR dry-run next week. Quick sync?
Theo R: +1. My vote is: preflight checks, routing canary, snapshot restore speed, and KV cache warming.
Priya S: I'll take snapshot restore speed and retention verification. Will run restores against the dev-snap bucket and report times.
Avery D: I'll own routing canary (DNS weights + graceful ramp). Suggest canary plan: 5% -> 25% after 20m -> 75% after 1h -> full after 3h.
Lena M: Nice. Who can add a cache-warm preflight step? We've had the flip-to-backup pattern when cache misses spike.
Theo R: I'll add cache-warm. Plan is: warm top-5k KVs in region before reroute, validate hit rate > 85% for 10m.
Priya S: For snapshot restores, I'll measure cold restore and restore with degraded network (tc/netem) and post results. ETA Thu.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2024-06-10 08:00 UTC "DR dry-run preflight"
ops-bot: Reminder created and added to #incidents calendar.
Avery D: Also recommend adding a short rollback smoke: after canary reach 25% run a rollback that reduces weight by 50% and validate request success. We'll need a scripted rollout.
Lena M: Can we capture the rollout script as a terraform plan + a small python harness? Put terraform change behind a feature flag and deploy with a one-off canary.
Theo R: here's a tiny harness snippet I'll paste into the runbook: ```bash
# bump canary weight to 5%
python canary_rollout.py --region us-west --target 5 --verify 120
# validate kv hit rate
python kv_health.py --region us-west --expected 0.85 --duration 600
```
Priya S: I'm going to create ticket INFR-701 and attach restore run outputs + checklist.
Lena M: Cool. Owners recap: preflight cache - Theo; snapshot restores - Priya; routing canary & rollout - Avery; runbook doc consolidation - Lena. Deadlines: owners post checklists by Wed EOD, test artifacts uploaded by Thu, dry-run Fri AM.
Avery D: I'll open the PR for the terraform diff and add a canary pipeline. Tagging @Theo R for review.
Theo R: I'll review the PR and add a healthcheck that rejects a full rollout if KV hit rate < 70% after 30m.
Priya S: One more note: recurring pattern detected across last three incidents where control-plane retries cause duplicate snapshot writes. I'll add a short verification step to confirm idempotent snapshot writes.
Lena M: Good catch. Add that to the preflight: verify snapshot idempotency and manifest checksums.
ops-bot: Note: DR-dryrun doc updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-701 (subtasks created)
Lena M: I'll send a 1-paragraph summary to ENG-ONCALL and schedule a 30m preflight call Thu 16:00 UTC. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've posted your checklist.
Theo R: :white_check_mark:
Priya S: :white_check_mark:
Avery D: :white_check_mark:
Lena M: Thanks all. We'll reopen this thread if anything slips or new patterns show up.
